title: Cuticura Original Bloom Talc
body_html: A cherished classic, Cuticura Original Bloom Talc has a delicate, wholesome and unique floral fragrance. It helps absorb excess moisture, controls body odour, carries sunscreen for protection from the sun and keeps you refreshingly fresh with a fragrance that lasts up to 8 hours.
